name: 奶油马卡龙
description: 奶油粉 #FFF3F0 + 雾紫 #A693C8 + 茶咖 #7B5B3E 三色柔调。H1 雾紫大胶囊卡片白字、H2 柔紫胶囊内联、H3 浅粉左条+圆角、blockquote 雾紫柔底大圆角、hr 粉渐变。圆润柔软基调，所有边角 border-radius 放大。适合生活美学/美妆/轻松随笔/治愈系。

styles.container: background-color: #FFF3F0; font-family: 'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;
styles.h1: font-size: 23px; font-weight: 700; color: #FFFFFF; text-align: center; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 36px; margin-bottom: 26px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #A693C8 0%, #C4A9D9 100%); border-radius: 20px; letter-spacing: 2px; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(166,147,200,0.35);
styles.h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #A693C8; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 30px; margin-bottom: 16px; display: inline-block; background: rgba(166,147,200,0.14); border-radius: 999px;
styles.h3: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #7B5B3E; line-height: 1.55; margin-top: 26px; margin-bottom: 12px; padding-left: 14px; border-left: 4px solid #F4A7B9; border-radius: 3px;
styles.h4: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; color: #A693C8; line-height: 1.6; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 10px;
styles.h5: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #7B5B3E; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.6;
styles.h6: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #A89099; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: 1.5px;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #5C4A52; line-height: 1.88; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.3px;
styles.blockquote: background: rgba(166,147,200,0.10); border-radius: 14px; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 22px; font-size: 15px; color: #7B5B3E; line-height: 1.8; border-left: none;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 15px; color: #7B5B3E; line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: 0.3px; background: transparent;
styles.a: color: #A693C8; text-decoration: none; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(166,147,200,0) 70%, rgba(244,167,185,0.4) 70%);
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 16px; display: block; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(166,147,200,0.18); margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; background: transparent;
styles.hr: margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 32px; height: 3px; border: none; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #F4A7B9, #A693C8, #F4A7B9, transparent); border-radius: 2px;
styles.code: background: #FFE8EA; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 92%; color: #E06080; font-family: 'SF Mono','JetBrains Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.pre: background: #FFF8F5; border: 1px solid #F5D8DC; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(244,167,185,0.12); color: #5C4A52; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 34px; background: rgba(166,147,200,0.18); color: #A693C8; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-weight: 600;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #5C4A52; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SF Mono','JetBrains Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(166,147,200,0.10);
styles.ol li::marker: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; min-width: 24px; background: rgba(166,147,200,0.18); color: #A693C8; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; margin-right: 10px; margin-top: 2px;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #5C4A52; line-height: 1.88; letter-spacing: 0.3px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #A89099; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
